key_insight: Long-range interactions let digital-analog quantum neural networks match short-range performance with fewer layers or shorter evolution times in supervised tasks.
engineering_relevance: Combining single-qubit gates with long-range analog evolution can reduce circuit resources and classical optimization overhead.
method: Alternate single-qubit digital operations with analog entangling evolution.
Use an Ising model with power-law interactions in analog blocks.
Study how interaction range, transverse field, and evolution time affect expressibility and trainability.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks cover supervised image classification and many-body phase detection, plus unsupervised phase detection where long- and short-range ansatzes yield complementary phase-diagram signatures.
watch_item: Long-range interactions do not improve unsupervised performance in every regime, so benefits depend on the task and operating conditions.
paper_title: Digital-Analog Quantum Neural Network with Long-Range Interactions
